name: Wrath of The Pumpkin Face
source:
Crupientia is a fictional U.S. state known for its exceptionally high IQ residents. Its local folklore tells of Pumpkin Face, a demon who devours children on Halloween.

It sounds like a fairy tale, but there’s a hint of truth behind the story...

[From [url=https://rozrywkafan.itch.io/wrath-of-the-pumpkin-face]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
克鲁宾蒂亚是一个虚构的美国州，以其极高的智商居民而闻名。当地的民间传说讲述了南瓜脸，一个在万圣节吞噬儿童的恶魔。

这听起来像是一个童话故事，但故事背后却隐藏着一丝真相……
